name: Kon Tum Prison
kicker: French-era prison museum in the centre
summary: French-era prison cells and displays in the city centre, about an hour and a half on site for 30,000 VND. Go in the morning, before the heat. Skip it if you wanted a light scenic walk: this is colonial prison history.
heroCaption: The courtyard and memorial in front of the hall
gettingThere: The prison is in the city centre, in the same walkable cluster as the wooden church. From Pleiku Airport, the bus or taxi into Kon Tum takes about an hour.

legs.heading: From central Kon Tum
legs.body: Walk from the wooden church or any hotel in the centre.

legs.heading: From Pleiku Airport (PXU)
legs.body: About an hour by bus or taxi to the centre: nearly 45 km by kontumtourism.com’s count, 51 km by Travelmath’s. Then walk.

admissionNote: 30,000 VND for an adult. Child price: Check on arrival.

links.label: Go Vietnam cluster page
links.note: 30,000 VND and about ninety minutes. No clock is printed.
